Chapter 1

Rhys looked at me across the table. Cassian leaned against the wall by the door.

"You are late," Rhys said.

"I know," I said. "I was busy."

"Busy with what?"

"Painting."

"Since when do you paint at night?"

I shrugged. "Since always."

"Fine," Cassian said. "Then paint us something."

"Maybe later," I said.

"Later then," Rhys said. "Later, always later."
